svg.aria-label: Level 3: the whole robot. Operator laptop over Wi-Fi to the CM4-Duino; a two-wire bus to six drives; each drive has its motor; a 24 V supply through the emergency stop and a fuse powers the drives and the servo converter; a USB-C adapter powers the CM4-Duino
